meta.title: Session Archive
meta.description: One folder per session, classified by output dimensions: 01-deliver / 02-source / 03-tools / 04-output / 05-reference / _trash. Empty buckets are never created; the root keeps only 4 files.

settings.structured: Structured layout (bucket per dimension, no empty buckets)
settings.extractCode: Extract code blocks into separate source files
settings.extractLongText: Save long text blocks as output files
settings.absorbWorkspaceRoot: Absorb workspace root (structured mode only writes a to-sort list)
settings.safetyScan: Pre-publish safety scan (keys, private keys, paths)
settings.cleanupHistoryDays: Keep history files for N days

buckets.src: Source (the only writable source of truth)
